changes_made.explanation: Consolidated duplicate task entries to single 'Other: Data-to-text Generation'. Removed 'encoder-decoder' and 'copy mechanism' as standalone models since they are already covered in other model descriptions. Consolidated output descriptions to single consistent description.

Consolidated the custom movement correspondence metrics under a single normalized name to avoid duplication. The paper uses BLEU and a custom metric for evaluating price movement expression correspondence.
No LLMs were used as judges in this 2020 paper. The paper uses traditional automatic metrics and does not mention any large language model evaluation.
No human evaluation was conducted in this paper. The evaluation is purely based on automatic metrics (BLEU and custom movement correspondence).

overall_notes: The paper focuses on data-to-text generation for market comments from time-series stock data, addressing the challenge of noisy alignments between data and text. The proposed model uses multi-timestep data and a copy mechanism to handle temporal misalignments. Evaluation is conducted using BLEU and a custom metric for movement expression correspondence. The extraction was generally accurate with minor normalization needed for consistency.
